This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through various removal spells and disruptive cards. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage, it aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck includes cards like Make Disappear and Siphon Insight to deal with threats, while also utilizing Corpse Appraiser and Reckoner Bankbuster for card advantage. The deck also features some powerful finishers like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bladecoil Serpent to close out the game once the opponent has been destabilized.

By controlling the board and outvaluing the opponent, this deck aims to grind out victories through superior card advantage and resource management.
